case: The `finding_sources` row for F6W-04 deleted -- a finding raised in F2-06-recheck-03.md, in the family the old `F6[A-DRVX]` sweep could not see at all.
why: This is the real defect F6Y-01 measured, restored to one row. Before the widening the eight F6W ids had NO source row and the sweep did not fail, because the pattern that built its required set excluded the family; the floor of 60 was computed over the same narrow output, so it did not notice either. With the family declared, deleting a row is a failure that names the finding. The fixture is what stops the pattern narrowing again: re-narrowing it to any range that omits F6W makes this fixture PASS, which this runner fails the build for.
expect_failure_contains: A STEP 6 FINDING IS RAISED IN A REVIEW AND HELD BY NO SOURCE ROW
